evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and refactors core chainstate storage, CDBWrapper error handling, and CCoinsView architecture.
rationale: Eliminates a data integrity hazard where CDBWrapper::Read() returned false on deserialization errors, masking database corruption as missing keys. It also simplifies the coin-view hierarchy by removing CCoinsViewErrorCatcher and marking coin lookups noexcept.
